component: Calendar item dialog Fluent sizing and saved labels

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The real iframe load listener conditionally waits for pending localization before measuring body dimensions. The test helper then accepts either a viewport that fits the content or three stable height comparisons. A settled height can still be smaller than scrollHeight, so the helper name/comment does not establish non-clipping or every translated label. Save/send controls separately remove Fluent IDs before restoring saved non-Fluent label and tooltiptext values. Required discussion retains a deleted-comment gap; support is public code only, with no fresh layout or migration run.
title: Calendar item sizing accepts fitting content or a stable-height fallback
